src/domain/Catalogue.ts: the private Maps products, stock and reserved are the aggregate's in-memory state. The file has no database, network, file system or framework code.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/domain/Catalogue.ts is a domain aggregate. It holds products, stock and reservations in Maps on the object itself. Those Maps are the aggregate's own state, not a persistence mechanism: there is no database, file I/O, ORM or serialisation. All of its behaviour is domain logic: checking stock availability, reserving stock with an invariant that rejects insufficient stock, and releasing reservations without letting the count go below zero. The file has no transport, HTTP, framework, logging or orchestration code. The lookups getProduct and getAllProducts let callers read the aggregate's contents. They give it a slight collection-like feel, but they are plain in-memory reads with no storage behind them, so they are not a repository responsibility moved into the domain. Every responsibility fits the domain layer.
